name: Rebel Without a Claus
source:
You’re the director of your small town’s holiday play, and you want everything to be perfect – but the town miscreant has other plans.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Rebel_Without_A_Claus]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你是小镇假日剧的导演，你希望一切都完美 - 但镇上的恶棍却有其他计划。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Rebel_Without_A_Claus]Choices Wikia[/url]]
